# 'Great to be back' - Cork City confirm Kevin Long signing

The 36-year-old international defender came through City's academy

Kevin Long arrives at Cork City. Pic via CCFC.ie 

Kevin Long arrives at Cork City. Pic via CCFC.ie

Wed, 11 Nov, 2026 - 16:46

Cian Locke

  

  

Cork City have confirmed the long anticipated signing of Ireland international defender Kevin Long. [...] The 36-year-old Corkman came through City's academy and made 17 first team appearances before moving to then English Premier League side Burnley in 2009.

As well as his 13 years at Turf Moor, Long had loan spells with Accrington Stanley, Rochdale, Portsmouth, Barnsley and MK Dons and went to on sign for Birmingham City and Major League Soccer side Toronto FC.
